description.value: KW Gardens Restaurant is a Chinese restaurant on King George Boulevard in Surrey, offering a full dine-in menu alongside takeout and online ordering with local delivery. The restaurant features a party-size menu for larger groups and notes allergen awareness for diners with food sensitivities. It is a sit-down Chinese dining option conveniently located along a major Surrey corridor.
